description:
Spacious 4-Bedroom Semi-Detached Family Home in Prime Residential Area.

Situated in a sought-after residential location near the city centre, this semi-detached property offers extended living space ideal for a growing family. The house comprises a generous living room, a cosy sitting room, and a versatile dining family room, ensuring ample room for relaxation and entertainment.

The property features a well-sized kitchen breakfast room, a bathroom, and a separate W.C., meeting the demands of modern family life. Outside, a large rear garden with a patio area provides a great outdoor space for leisure activities, while the property also benefits from ample off-street parking and a detached garage for convenience and storage.

While some refurbishment is required, this home has the potential to be transformed into a wonderful family residence. Don't miss out on the opportunity to make this property your own – contact us today to schedule a viewing.

Directions Leave the city centre heading west onto Newtown Road, The property is located on the right-hand side.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
